name: Depth Probability Volume Estimation
definition: A 3D CNN converts the cost volume Vc into a depth probability volume Vp and a 3D feature volume F_cv. Vp is used to calculate estimated depth D and confidence interval S.
summary: Depth Probability Volume Estimation converts multi-view features into a 3D probabilistic depth distribution, distinguishing itself by explicitly modeling depth uncertainty for robust stereo and novel view synthesis.
